name: ZOHD Bamboo Toothbrush for Kids Pack of 2 | Soft Bristles | Eco-Friendly Wooden Toothbrush | Natural Bamboo Handle | Plastic-Free Kids Oral Care
description:
Make brushing fun and eco-friendly with the ZOHD Bamboo Toothbrush Combo for Kids. Designed specifically for children's delicate teeth and gums, these toothbrushes feature ultra-soft BPA-free bristles that provide gentle yet effective cleaning. The smooth, lightweight bamboo handle is easy for little hands to hold and is made from responsibly sourced natural bamboo, offering a sustainable alternative to plastic toothbrushes.
